messages:
elaine: quick design drop 1 — proposing a compact left-side onboarding tray ("mini-tray") that shows progress dots and a small status chip. expands to a full checklist on click. want quick takes on discovery vs clutter, keyboard flow, and telemetry.

sam: mini-tray is promising for low-friction entry. question: do we persist it after a user completes steps or hide it?

marta: keep it persistently visible but collapsed after completion as a small summary chip. that keeps users aware of status without re-driving the flow.

oliver: a11y baseline: keep tray in DOM always so keyboard users can tab to it. when collapsed use aria-hidden="true" on inner region; when expanded move focus to first interactive control. ensure contrast on the chip label is >=4.5:1.

tariq: engineering caveats: sticky left tray will overlap responsive sidebars on narrow widths. propose breakpoint at 1040px where tray becomes inline above canvas. will implement sticky via position: sticky and top offset to account for header.

kai: microcopy suggestion: use verbs like "Try sample" and for completed state "Setup complete". shorter labels read better in small chips. also add tooltip for first-time hover.

sam: agree on copy. also add a tiny dismiss action "Hide" and a snooze "Remind me" to differentiate metrics. marta: we'll need different telemetry keys for hide vs snooze.

marta: will add keys: onboarding.tray.view, onboarding.tray.expand, onboarding.tray.snooze, onboarding.tray.hide, onboarding.step.complete. separate events for auto-collapse vs user-hide.

oliver: keyboard flow specifics: 1) collapsed tray should be reachable in the standard tab order; 2) activate expands and focus goes to the first checkbox; 3) Esc collapses and returns focus to the tray toggle; 4) close button must be first tabbable element inside expanded region. include visible 3px high-contrast focus ring.

tariq: for animations, keep to composited properties. code snippet below:

```css
.mini-tray { position: sticky; top: 72px; will-change: transform, opacity; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), opacity 120ms linear; }
.mini-tray--collapsed { transform: translateX(-6px); opacity: 0.98; }
.mini-tray--expanded { transform: translateX(0); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .mini-tray { transition: none; } }
```

oliver: prefer translateX to keep it composited. also avoid using role="dialog" for the expanded checklist; use role="region" with aria-labelledby so it's announced but not modal. trap focus only inside the expanded panel while it's open, with an accessible close control.

sam: UX question: should the tray show progress as dots only, or include a percentage text? dots are minimal but percentage helps clarity. maybe show dots by default and reveal percentage on hover or focus.

marta: telemetry-wise show percentage event on reveal but not on simple hover to avoid noise. add impression gating for first 3 sessions.

kai: tiny UX nit: icons inside the tray need alt text and accessible labels for screen readers (e.g., "Step 1: create API key").

elaine: summary of action items: sam - update mock with percent-on-focus variant and copy tweaks; tariq - prototype sticky behaviour + responsive breakpoint and implement reduced-motion; oliver - draft final a11y checklist and focus ring CSS; marta - add telemetry keys and gating rules; kai - prepare alt-text suggestions for sample projects. scheduling quick sync Thu 9am to review.

deploy-bot: reminder: onboarding surfaces design freeze Friday 5pm PT. link final comps to release ticket.

sam: will upload updated frames Wed night and tag oliver for a11y review. :thumbsup:
